What is Own The Doge?

Own The Doge is a collective backed by the original Doge meme, endorsed by Atsuko Sato and the dog we all know and love, Kabosu. Our mission is to use the Doge meme and IP to pursue, propel and proliferate the ethos of D.O.G.E. (Doing Only Good Everyday)

To join in on the fun, follow us on X, join the community (Discord, Telegram), and keep reading below to find out how you can bring Doge to places she’s never been.

Charity

Own The Doge is committed to giving back to charity at every pawsibility just like our inspiration Atsuko Sato, the Dogemother.


Since inception, Own The Doge has donated over $2M USD to charities supporting dogs and kids. We are currently the all-time largest donor of crypto to Save The Children.

Endorsed by Dogemother Atsuko Sato

The Dogemother, Atsuko Sato, talks about her longstanding relationship with Own The Doge from The Doge NFT auction to collaborating on multiple projects together (Doge Statue, Couch Charity Auction, Doge Film) to why she chose to give Own The Doge the exclusive IP license of Doge and Kabosu.

History

Doge is the most famous dog in the world. She’s spanned every era of the Internet over nearly two decades. First, she became famous as Kabosu on Atsuko Sato’s blog. She was one of the first famous ‘dog influencers’ in Japan. Then was popularized on Reddit as a meme and named “Doge” by John Monarch. Finally, Doge entered the crypto realm as the face of Dogecoin.


But the first time Atsuko Sato and Kabosu were ever reconnected to the Doge movement was through The Doge NFT auction, which allowed Own The Doge to build a direct connection to the meme, dog, and owner back to the people.

Discover the full history

The Doge NFT

In 2021, Atsuko Sato minted the iconic Doge photo onchain appropriately named The Doge NFT. The auction was won by PleasrDAO for a startling 1696.9 ETH. Approximately USD $4,240,000 million at the time, this makes it the fourth most expensive photo ever sold in the history of the world.
